content: Pool Nyil Afisus
Kaaɗe Apolos ɗi nɗǝǝn Koronti, ɓǝ Pool nkaa mwaan nɗǝǝn yil mo, ɓǝ wur jì wul Afisus. Yaksǝ wur jì kat pak nenseet nɗang Jesu mo ɗi mpee nkaam mǝnǝ.
Ɓǝ wur tal pǝ mo nǝnee, <<Kaaɗe dǝ wu shinzeen, ɓǝ wuu lap Riin Ɗeɓang ee?>> Mo lap nwur nǝnee, <<Hai, baa muu cam kǝlǝng mee pwoo nkaa Riin Ɗeɓang kas.>>
Wur tal pǝ mo nǝnee, <<Ɓǝ dǝ mo cìn a baptisma ɗǝɗang nwun yii?>> Mo lap nǝnee, <<A baptisma mǝ Joon.>>
Pool sat mmo nǝnee, <<Baptisma mǝ Joon nǝ a mbǝ nen ɗe mo kǝ tuwap. Gyet Joon sat nnen Yahudi mo shinzeen a ngwe ɗewur mbǝ jì mɓwoon fin. A Jesu mmǝnǝ.>>
Kaaɗe mo kǝlǝng pwoo ɗesǝ, ɓǝ mo cìn baptisma mmo nɗǝǝn sǝm kǝ Daa Jesu.
Pool lesar fin nkaa mo, ɓǝ Riin Ɗeɓang sham nkaa mo, ɓǝ mo leshap shi liispwoo ɗecì mo, ɗang mo satpwoo Naan ngurum mo.
Nen ɗe mo lap baptisma nǝ, mo wul kaapaat baavǝl.
Pool wur ɗel nɗǝǝn lu Naan, mbǝ tar mo kun, ɓǝ wur leshap nǝ, baa ashak kǝ kǝǝrmuut kas, kǝzak wur cìn ɓeetshik kǝ mo, ɗang wur ɗaar mbǝkǝ nwur kám ɗe mmo agaak nkaa mulki mǝ Naan.

Ɗangɓǝ pak mo cǝǝr ɓal mputuup, kǝ mmo cii shinzeen, ɓǝ mo leshap ɗebuu nkaa pwoo mǝ Naan ntoom gurum mo jir. Aasǝ ɓǝ, Pool yit mo ɗe, ɓǝ wur pǝrep nen shinzeen nǝ mo shin jì ashak. Ɓǝ koo a puus ɗeɗangyii, ɓǝ wur yakshii kǝ pwoo mo nɗǝǝn lu kam-kam ɗe mǝ Tairanus.
Moo naa ncìn a kǝsǝ dǝm wul mbǝ ɓit vǝl. Aasǝ ɓǝ, nen ɗe mo kǝ tong nɗǝǝn yil Eshiya, nen Yahudi mo, kǝ nnen ɗe baa mo a nen Yahudi mo kas, mo jir mo kǝlǝng pwoo kǝ Naan.
Jep Skiiva Mo
Naan le kǝ Pool cìn mbii lukshik mo ɗes, ɗe baa mo kǝ cam naa mo kas.

Nǝ le har mmo lap lee ɗewur kǝ pwes wun ɗishik, kǝ nlǝr ɗewur kǝ lep mo, kǝ mo dǝm tung nengok mo ɗishik, ɓǝ mo kat bar nɗǝǝn shwal mo mo shini-shini, kǝzak riin ɗebish mo pwat mɓut ngurum mo ɗes zak.

Ɗangɓǝ mee des mo ɗi mɓut nnen Yahudi mo, ɗe moo mwaan dǝm shiyil-shiyil, kǝn mmo kǝ ceen riin ɗebish mo ɗi. Mo ɗoom leshap nnen ɗe mo kǝ riin ɗebish mo nɗǝǝn sǝm mǝ Jesu, ɓǝ mo sat nǝnee, <<Nɗǝǝn sǝm mǝ Jesu ɗe Pool kǝ leshap nkaa wur sǝ, ɓǝ an nsat ngha, a put aku.>>
Mee ɗyemnǝǝnshak mo ɗi pwoovǝl, ɗe mo a jep mee pris ɗeɗes mǝ nnen Yahudi mo, ɗi sǝm wur a Skiiva. A mo a nnen cìn mǝnǝ.
Riin ɗebish nǝ lap mmo nǝnee, <<Wen man Jesu, kǝ wen mman Pool zak, ɗang wun a wii mo yii?>>
Ɓǝ gwar ɗewur kǝ riin ɗebish nǝ, wur yool met nkaa mo, ɓǝ wur met mmo mɓal jir mo. Wur nas mo, ɗang wur le láa mmo, ɓǝ wur yilang nlǝr mmo, ɓǝ mo yool shwe pwat nɗǝǝn lu nǝ ngúm, ɓǝ toom kǝ sham mmo.
Kaaɗe mbii ɗesǝ nǝ ɗee a ɗemǝman pǝ nnen Yahudi mo, kǝ nnen Heleni mo ɗe mo kǝ tong nɗǝǝn yil Afisus, ɓǝ kǝǝrmuut yaa mo jir, ɓǝ gurum mo le ɗeɗes nsǝm kǝ Daa Jesu.
Gurum mo ɗes mɓut nnen ɗe mo shinzeen, mo jì woo shikbish mo mo, kǝ ɗak mo ɗebish mo agaak zak.

Pak gurum mo ɗes mɓut nnen ɗe moo cìn yen ɗebish mǝ gwampee mo, mo kok ɓǝǝt-haal mǝ yen mo nǝ mo, kǝn mmo jì fwoo mo nwus ntoom gurum nǝ mo jir. Kaaɗe mo tang shool mǝ ɓǝǝt-haal ɗe mo fwo nwus nǝ mo, ɓǝ mo kat shool azurfa mo wul ngal laarpaat.
Aasǝ ɓǝ, pwoo mǝ Daa nǝ mwaan shipee-shipee jir, nǝ le nǝ ɓal hakyeng.
Demetriyus Yool Kǝ Pwoo Ɗebish Nkaa Pool

Aɓwoon ɗe mbii ɗesǝ mo kǝ cìn, ɓǝ Pool naa nǝ ret nǝ, kǝ nɗyin dǝm nJerusalem, ɓǝ ɗyin mbǝ yaa ar nǝ dǝm put a mMasidoniya kǝ Akaya. Ɓǝ wur sat nǝnee, <<Aɓwoon ɗe an ndǝm wul nJerusalem, ɓǝ nǝ atǝng an mbǝ ndǝm nyil nRom zak.>>
Pool lep Timoti kǝ Erastus ɗe mo a nenɓam wur mo, kǝ mmo dǝm mMasidoniya akyeen wur, ɗang wur shikáa fin, wur mpan yém ɗi lee nɗǝǝn yil Eshiya nǝ.
Nciit kǝ mǝnǝ, ɓǝ gurum mo yool kǝ pwoo ɗebish ɗe nǝ daampee zam nkaa pwoo Naan nǝ.

Mee ngukǝlem, ɗewur kǝ ɗak mbii mo shi azurfa, ɗe moo pet sǝm wur a Demetriyus. Wur naa nkǝlem pak jep kùm mo, shi azurfa ɗe mo lapshak kǝ war kùm Atemis ɗeɗes nǝ, ɓǝ ɗak ɗesǝ nii jì kǝ shool nnenkǝlem nǝ mo zam.
Demetriyus pǝrep nenkǝlem nǝ mo jì ashak jir, kǝ nen ɗe ɗak mo nǝ mo, a koo mǝ nenkǝlem nǝ mo sǝ zak. Yaksǝ wur sat mmo nǝnee, <<Daa mo! Wu man nǝ, mmun muu kat shool ɗes a nɗǝǝn ɗak fun ɗesǝ.

Yaksǝ wun shikáa fuu, ɓǝ wu naa, kǝ wuu kǝlǝng mbii ɗe gwar ɗe moo pet wur a Pool sǝ wur kǝ cìn. Wur sat nǝ, naan ɗe gurum mo kǝ ɗak mo a shi sar, ɓǝ baa mo a naan kas koo lee lee, ɗang wur ciir kǝ pǝtuup gurum mo ɗes nɗǝǝn pee nkaam Afisus, kǝ yil ɗe mo ngaar Eshiya jir. Nǝ, taji mo seet kùm nǝ mo kas.

Wu naa zak, yaksǝ baa ɗak fun nǝ kutɗi kǝ mee sǝm ɗeret kas. Baa a ɗak fun nǝ ɓejee ɗak kas, kǝ Atemis ɗeɗes, war mbǝ ɗee a mbii shwar ngurum mo, kǝ naan nǝ war shikáa fer zak. Gurum ɗe mo ngaar yil Eshiya, kǝ yil sǝ jir, mo kǝ seyil a nwar.>>
Kaaɗe mo kǝlǝng pwoo mǝnǝ, ɓǝ nǝ láa mmo mɓut zam, mo le or pwoo mǝndong, mo sat nǝnee, <<Atemis mǝ Afisus war a ɗeɗes!>>
Gurum ɗe mo nɗǝǝn pee nkaam nǝ, mo jir mo lap or nǝ zak. Gurum nǝ mo dǝm yaa Gayus kǝ Aristakus ɗe mo a nen Masidoniya mo, kǝ ɗe mo a shaar mwaan mǝ Pool, ɓǝ mo dǝm kǝ mo kǝkǝlak a peekuur.
Pool reɓet dǝm ɗar akyeen gurum nǝ mo, ɓǝ nenseet nɗang Jesu mo cíi nwur.
Pak nen ɗenan-nan ɗe nyil Eshiya mo, ɗe mo a shaar Pool. Mo lep shindǝm nwur nǝ, taji wur dǝm ɗi a peekuur nǝ kas.
Gurum nǝ mo le or a peekuur nǝ jir, mon nkaa sat mbii mo shini-shini, mbǝɗe ɗes mǝ gurum nǝ mo, baa mo man mbii ɗe nǝ le kǝ mo kuur ashak kas.

Nen Yahudi mo le kǝn Alekzanda dǝm ɗar akyeen mǝ gurum nǝ mo, ɓǝ wur ɗiyeep sar, mbǝkǝ ngurum nǝ mo ɗok ɗi tǝtǝk, mbǝɗe wur kǝ reɓet leshap ngurum nǝ mo nǝ, baa ɗyin kǝ nen fin mo, ɗuu cìn mee mbii ɗebish kas. Mbǝɗǝ kaaɗe gurum nǝ mo naa Alekzanda kǝ ɗar akyeen, ɓǝ mo pan nǝ, a wur kǝ mbii nǝ.
Kǝzak kaaɗe mo naa nǝ, wur a ngu Yahudi, ɓǝ mo sǝǝt le or pwoo mǝndong jir, mbǝ awa vǝl. Mo nkaa sat nǝnee, <<Atemis, kǝ nǝ Afisus mo, war a ɗeɗes!>>

Kaaɗe nguran mǝ pee nkaam nǝ wur le kǝ ngurum mo ɗok tǝtǝk, ɓǝ wur sat mmo nǝnee, <<Wun nen Afisus mo! A wii nook man nǝ, a wun a nnen ɗe wun pǝ tap kǝ lu kùm mǝ Atemis ɗeɗes nɗǝǝn Afisus kas yii? Kǝzak nghǝk ɗe gyet nǝ tong aɗeng sham taa mpee ɗesǝ kas yii?
Baa mee gurum mak cíipwoo mǝ mbii ɗesǝ mo kas. Mbǝ mǝnǝ ɓǝ nǝ ret kǝ nwun tong coot, taji wu cìn mee mbii kǝkǝlak kǝsǝ kas.
Wun wu jì kǝ nen ɗesǝ mo mpee ɗesǝ, ɓǝ baa mo kǝ cìn mee wat nɗǝǝn lu kùm fuu nǝ mo kas, kǝ baa mo sat mee pwoo ɗebish nkaa naan fuu ɗeɗes war kas zak.
Katɗang Demetriyus ashak kǝ nniyee fin mo, mo kǝ mee pwoo nkaa mee gurum, ɓǝ mo dǝm kǝ pwoo nǝ nluɗyeel mpee ɗe nenɗyeel mo ɗi, mbǝkǝ mmo ɓeetpwoo nǝ ɗi.
Ɗangɓǝ kat wun pǝ tang a mee mbii ɗecì, ɓǝ wu ɓeetpwoo mǝnǝ a peekuur kǝ nenyil nǝ mo.
Azeen-zeen mun mbǝ teer ɗiɓut katɗang mo dǝm kǝ mun nluɗyeel mbǝ or ɗǝ cicinsǝ, mbǝɗe baa mun manshii mǝ mbii ɗe wun pǝ ɗyeep or nkaa nǝ kas, kǝzak, baa kuur fuu nǝ kǝ mee koop nǝ kas.>>
Aɓwoon ɗewur kǝ leshap mǝnǝ, ɓǝ wur sat ngurum nǝ mo dǝm ntul mo.
